programme.title: 野狗: 与族群一起奔跑 #4
programme.desc: 在享受偷来的盛宴时,躲避了一只猎豹和曼兹狗群。但卡库里族群在狩猎中就没这么幸运了,因为它们被一只勇敢的普库羚羊挫败了。找到鹳群,和朱尔斯和西蒙一起逃避冲锋中的大象。

programme.title: 爱尔兰: 野性岛屿 #1 英普
programme.desc: 见证栖身于西海岸的不同物种,如何忍受严冬并迎接初春的来临。亲眼目睹在强风下的红鹿激战,在风声呼啸的暴风雨中欢迎海豹宝宝来临,以及象鲨群的回归。

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥伦比亚海岸附近,新生的座头鲸吸了牠的第一口气。牠身长16呎,是一个巨人,但未来的挑战跟牠一样巨大。在进行地球上最长的迁徙之一前,牠必须快点长大。

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 随著松鼠猴的繁殖季节临近,女强人艾巴必须带领牠的团伙寻找食物,但男领袖撒母耳能夺得芳心吗?年轻的沙奇拿迷了路,而敌人逐渐紧逼,局势开始紧张。

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 在秘鲁的山脉,一小群眼镜熊为生存而战。孤儿阿马逊娜必须学会独立。老去的东哥没时间找到配偶,很难才能俘虏理想对象曹莉达。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #1 英普
programme.desc: 视野对生存尤关重要。这是百分之九十五的动物了解世界的方法。眼睛是如此重要,从难以置信地简单到令人费解地复杂,它们已经独立地进化了近百次。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #2 英普
programme.desc: 看看那些突破物理、化学和工程极限的动物,牠们实现人类梦想中的能力,并找出进化如何赋予牠们如此惊人的能力。有时生存只能依靠超能力。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #3 英普
programme.desc: 潜入人类感知以外令人眼花缭乱的世界,动物利用牠们的超感官来感测我们看不到的光、听不到的声音,甚至是我们无法察觉的陌生力量。

programme.title: 啄木鸟: 树洞故事
programme.desc: 伴随著一个独特的鸟类家族的稳定鼓点行进。了解为何世界上从大到小的239种啄木鸟都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠们的飞行、攀爬和呼叫技能;进入牠们的秘密巢穴一探究竟。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #1 英普
programme.desc: 见证斗士们如何在非洲大草原的旱季中争夺水源和其他珍贵资源。亲眼目击狮子和大象为争夺地盘的激烈争斗、蚂蚁袭击白蚁丘、以及蜜獾与毒蛇联袂上演的危险探戈。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜访澳洲最狡猾的斗士和他们惊人的武器库。从袋鼠的致命拳击和红背蜘蛛精密设计的陷阱,暸解他们如何运用这些必杀技击退敌人,同时应对气候变化的侵害。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #3 英普
programme.desc: 齐来为年轻的格斗士们鼓掌,并亲眼见证他们在美洲茂密的热带森林中奋力拼搏!然后退后一步,观察一只毒箭蛙发动绝活攻势、还有美洲豹和凯门鳄争夺地盘,以及见证一只饥饿的长鼻狸与猛蜘蛛的邂逅。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #4 英普
programme.desc: 前往美国极北地带,拜访沿著水道生活的终极格斗士。春回大地,看到融雪就知道格斗随时上演: 鹰与鹭的对决、熊族对阵,以及蜻蜓蛹与大型水虫之间的决斗。

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与丹一同踏上旅程,穿越严酷无情的蒙古荒野,只为寻找那只史上有纪录以来体型最大的雪豹: 「老兄」(The Dude)。目睹他如何在充满敌意、危机四伏的地形与环境中奋力前行,并在未知与不确定中披荆斩棘,同时揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面临的艰难挑战与严峻现实。

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟随丹与他的团队,一同在「老兄」的领地中嗅探、追踪,他们怀疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能远比先前想像的更加关键、更具影响力。当丹意外发现一群雪豹聚集的反常现象时,对雪豹行为的既有研究与认知也因此受到冲击与挑战。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #1
programme.desc: 跟随丽兹·戴利及其团队前往潘塔纳尔,追寻一只失踪的雄性美洲豹领袖,并亲眼目睹年轻挑战者之间的战斗。见证局外人巴达洛如何篡夺权力,并赢得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的欢心。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #2
programme.desc: 一起拜会潘塔纳尔美洲豹族群的女王菲拉,从旁观察她教导淘气的幼宝宝辛巴如何爬树和捕猎。然后看看另一只雌豹菲琳娜如何面对更多当地雄豹入侵领土,并威胁幼宝宝的存活。面对考验,她必须为母职挣扎坚持。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #3
programme.desc: 跟随科学家团队在雨季过后重新走入美洲豹领地,进行一次具规模的搜索,以寻找菲琳娜、菲拉和巴达洛,因为他们的追踪项圈已经丢失。迎接一位生物学家加入团队,在他的协助下,丽兹·戴利为美洲豹重新安装追踪项圈,并添置高科技设备以记录更多数据。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #4
programme.desc: 经历风暴、洪水和停电,莉兹和兽医霍亚雷斯仍奋力为更多美洲豹戴上项圈,情势相当紧张。一起寻找巴达洛的下落,并尝试在追踪标签掉落之前找到他,以及拜访一只团队渴望研究的新䧳豹。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #5
programme.desc: 见证奥玛法瑞团队为新认识的䧳豹阿罗艾拉戴上项圈,并一瞥她的豹宝宝阿波罗。继续追查巴达洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失踪可能让莉兹的突破性研究毁于一旦!

programme.title: 野狗: 与族群一起奔跑 #5
programme.desc: 和朱尔兹在捕猎行动中追上曼兹族群,和他一起拍摄一场野狗捕猎大战;在卡库里族群冒著巨大的风险等待雨季到来时,留意猎豹和鬣狗的活动。与一只归来的鹤群公犬一起进行一次史诗般的狩猎。

programme.title: 爱尔兰: 野性岛屿 #2 英普
programme.desc: 走访世界著名的斯凯利群岛,穿梭令人眼花缭乱的峭壁,并探索一座有1500年历史的修道院。拜访栖身曼岛的薙鸟和座头鲸,然后在克莱尔追逐矮小的鼩鼱。最后来到阿兰群岛,一睹秋季的壮观景象。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #1 英普
programme.desc: 跟著名叫奥廉巴的莽撞雌豹,游览尚比亚卢安瓜谷的心脏地带。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #2 英普
programme.desc: 奈士富狮群生活在尚比亚的卢安瓜河畔。见证经验丰富的雌狮养育一群幼狮,还有牠们如何在恶劣环境中努力生存。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #3 英普
programme.desc: 两头大雄狮,有著强大的兄弟情谊,统治了奈士富狮群三年,但三年是很长的统治期,其他竞争者逐步进逼。两兄弟将要竭力保护家族和领导地位。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #4 英普
programme.desc: 一头名叫美祖木的年轻雄性鬣狗的故事,围绕生命中最具挑战性的旅程- 找一个新家族。作为一名主导雌性的儿子,牠有一个被优待的童年,但当牠的地位在青春期时下降,因牠被母亲放逐了。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 一个野狗家族生活在尚比亚卢安瓜谷的一角。雌性的巢内有幼崽,这是她和伴侣生养的最新一窝。许多年龄较大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠们帮助作保姆,并狩猎食物养活家人。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 在鬣狗家族中有一个新面孔。 斑斑注定要成为位于尚比亚卢安瓜谷心脏地带斑鬣狗族群的首领。她自出生起已有崇高身份,但她仍然需要证明自己。族群是一个危险的地方,她必须为自己打出一席位。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #1 英普
programme.desc: 与非洲森林象一同穿越纳米比亚沙漠,窥探牠们如何在缺乏食物与遮蔽的环境中保持凉爽。了解这头巨兽如何挑选特定植物充饥、挖掘水井,并翻越无尽的沙丘寻找珍贵水源。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #2 英普
programme.desc: 走访婆罗洲的红树林,与湾鳄一同航行,并见证牠们在盘根错节的水生植物之间穿梭自如。了解牠们如何利用环境调节体温,以及如何凭借惊人的耐性一跃成为顶尖猎手。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #3 英普
programme.desc: 红毛猩猩是丛林中的建筑大师。跟随麦克斯来到婆罗洲的雨林,一起探索这种独居灵长类动物的筑巢艺术。然后见证麦克斯如何尝试逃离满布昆虫的地面,并从红毛猩猩身上学习自然界工程技巧。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #4 英普
programme.desc: 跟随麦克斯来到卢安达的森林追踪黑猩猩,他试图说服这些强壮的猴子相信他是朋友而非敌人。一起学习在丛林觅食的关键技巧,并见证黑猩猩复杂的家庭动态,包括梳理毛发和社交活动。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #5 英普
programme.desc: 跟随麦可斯探索斯里兰卡,窥探懒熊常被误解的神秘世界。见证这种看似人畜无害、毛发蓬乱的动物,如何无畏地击退豹子,并观察牠们如何努力获取所需的营养。

programme.title: 翱翔澳洲 #1
programme.desc: 从内部干燥的平原上可以看到澳洲最知名的影像,红色巨石乌卢鲁,慵懒地跳跃的红色袋鼠; 澳洲的干旱中心地带是巨大又具标志性的。

programme.title: 翱翔澳洲 #2
programme.desc: 大狄维亭山脉被巨大的力量所打造,从大陆的中心地带以一条细长的绿色丝带分开。从塔斯曼尼亚的冰冷山峰经过1800英里,到达古老的戴恩树雨林,无数的物种以大狄维亭山脉为家,全都适应地生存,并茁壮成长。

programme.title: 野火劫后 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近发生灾难性森林大火的后续,透过充满希望、人为干预和复原力的故事,记录野生动植物的长期恢复情况。本节目发放了一个十万火急的讯息,不要太迟爱护大自然。

programme.title: 金伯利: 澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与小袋鼠一起躲避长满鳞片与覆满羽毛的危险威胁,观察库拉马那蜥蜴为了争夺配偶而激烈交战,并与刚孵化的鳄鱼幼体一同进食。在雨季来临之际,勇闯危险的急流,理解一条在地河流在文化层面与生物层面上的重要意义。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #1 英普
programme.desc: 认识在喀拉哈里盆地合力确保共存的罕有合作者。了解大象族群与结果白相思树的共生关系、猫鼬与吵闹卷尾鸟的联盟,以及更多一对对动物相。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #2 英普
programme.desc: 喀拉哈里的动物们渴望雨水,因为牠们已经忍受了极端干旱的一年。见证象群在拼命寻找水源时的合作,邂逅帮助小猫鼬生存的奇怪保姆。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #3 英普
programme.desc: 跟随到达喀拉哈里沙漠的科学家并验证一个假设: 动物合作是该地区爆发物种多样性的关键。观察他们监控行为、破译数据,并得出引人入胜的结论。

programme.title: 野狗: 与族群一起奔跑 #3
programme.desc: 为一只丢失的鹳群幼崽苦恼,与正在等级战斗的曼兹幼崽打成一片,了解吵闹邻居中的朋友和敌人。和朱尔兹一起在荒凉的不毛之地寻找失踪的卡库里族群。

programme.title: 成为大象: 瑞提提的孤儿们 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社区经营的瑞特提大象庇护所,在这里,人类的代理妈妈们透过玩耍教导小象如何在野外生存,并细心地照顾与陪伴牠们成长。与那只失去象鼻的小象隆乌洛建立情感连结,同时了解为什么六岁的小象凯勒勒那场神秘的疾病,可能会让牠的重返野外之路被迫延迟。

programme.title: 成为大象: 瑞提提的孤儿们 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道别的伤痛与对未来的希望之间寻求平衡,因为这一代被救援的大象,终于迎来了重返自由的时刻。欢迎瑞特提大家庭的新成员: 一头从水坑中被救出的象宝宝,以及一匹名叫奇希玛的斑马,牠曾因创伤而惊恐不安。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看动物穿越天空展开非凡的旅程。穿梭在木制迷宫中的迅捷苍鹰,加入沙鸡艰辛远行到遥远水源的跋涉,并观赏一群椋鸟形成的壮观集体盘旋,迷惑牠们的天敌。

programme.title: 地球演化实录 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的岛屿,其多样性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前发生。从加拉帕戈斯群岛走到南极洲,看看海狮、雀鸟、蟋蟀、猴子和其他野生动物,如何以惊人的适应力来应对气候变化问题。

programme.title: 地球演化实录 #3 英普
programme.desc: 从撒哈拉到荒野,于极端环境中学习动物如何适应急速变化的气候并挣扎求存。与黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避难、看看骆驼以特别技巧饮用盐水,并倾听斑胸草雀为蛋宝宝由唱的歌,了解歌声如何让幼雏变得细小。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #4 英普
programme.desc: 前往美国极北地带,拜访沿著水道生活的终极格斗士。春回大地,看到融雪就知道格斗随时上演: 鹰与鹭的对决、熊族对阵,以及蜻蜓蛹与大型水虫之间的决斗。

programme.title: 野狗: 与族群一起奔跑 #4
programme.desc: 在享受偷来的盛宴时,躲避了一只猎豹和曼兹狗群。但卡库里族群在狩猎中就没这么幸运了,因为它们被一只勇敢的普库羚羊挫败了。找到鹳群,和朱尔斯和西蒙一起逃避冲锋中的大象。

programme.title: 爱尔兰: 野性岛屿 #1 英普
programme.desc: 见证栖身于西海岸的不同物种,如何忍受严冬并迎接初春的来临。亲眼目睹在强风下的红鹿激战,在风声呼啸的暴风雨中欢迎海豹宝宝来临,以及象鲨群的回归。

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 哥伦比亚海岸附近,新生的座头鲸吸了牠的第一口气。牠身长16呎,是一个巨人,但未来的挑战跟牠一样巨大。在进行地球上最长的迁徙之一前,牠必须快点长大。

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #2
programme.desc: 随著松鼠猴的繁殖季节临近,女强人艾巴必须带领牠的团伙寻找食物,但男领袖撒母耳能夺得芳心吗?年轻的沙奇拿迷了路,而敌人逐渐紧逼,局势开始紧张。

programme.title: 拉丁美生态奥秘 #3
programme.desc: 在秘鲁的山脉,一小群眼镜熊为生存而战。孤儿阿马逊娜必须学会独立。老去的东哥没时间找到配偶,很难才能俘虏理想对象曹莉达。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #1 英普
programme.desc: 视野对生存尤关重要。这是百分之九十五的动物了解世界的方法。眼睛是如此重要,从难以置信地简单到令人费解地复杂,它们已经独立地进化了近百次。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #2 英普
programme.desc: 看看那些突破物理、化学和工程极限的动物,牠们实现人类梦想中的能力,并找出进化如何赋予牠们如此惊人的能力。有时生存只能依靠超能力。

programme.title: 动物超感官 第一季 #3 英普
programme.desc: 潜入人类感知以外令人眼花缭乱的世界,动物利用牠们的超感官来感测我们看不到的光、听不到的声音,甚至是我们无法察觉的陌生力量。

programme.title: 啄木鸟: 树洞故事
programme.desc: 伴随著一个独特的鸟类家族的稳定鼓点行进。了解为何世界上从大到小的239种啄木鸟都是自然界最好的伐木工;探索牠们的飞行、攀爬和呼叫技能;进入牠们的秘密巢穴一探究竟。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #1 英普
programme.desc: 见证斗士们如何在非洲大草原的旱季中争夺水源和其他珍贵资源。亲眼目击狮子和大象为争夺地盘的激烈争斗、蚂蚁袭击白蚁丘、以及蜜獾与毒蛇联袂上演的危险探戈。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #2 英普
programme.desc: 拜访澳洲最狡猾的斗士和他们惊人的武器库。从袋鼠的致命拳击和红背蜘蛛精密设计的陷阱,暸解他们如何运用这些必杀技击退敌人,同时应对气候变化的侵害。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #3 英普
programme.desc: 齐来为年轻的格斗士们鼓掌,并亲眼见证他们在美洲茂密的热带森林中奋力拼搏!然后退后一步,观察一只毒箭蛙发动绝活攻势、还有美洲豹和凯门鳄争夺地盘,以及见证一只饥饿的长鼻狸与猛蜘蛛的邂逅。

programme.title: 动物格斗士 #4 英普
programme.desc: 前往美国极北地带,拜访沿著水道生活的终极格斗士。春回大地,看到融雪就知道格斗随时上演: 鹰与鹭的对决、熊族对阵,以及蜻蜓蛹与大型水虫之间的决斗。

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与丹一同踏上旅程,穿越严酷无情的蒙古荒野,只为寻找那只史上有纪录以来体型最大的雪豹: 「老兄」(The Dude)。目睹他如何在充满敌意、危机四伏的地形与环境中奋力前行,并在未知与不确定中披荆斩棘,同时揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面临的艰难挑战与严峻现实。

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟随丹与他的团队,一同在「老兄」的领地中嗅探、追踪,他们怀疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能远比先前想像的更加关键、更具影响力。当丹意外发现一群雪豹聚集的反常现象时,对雪豹行为的既有研究与认知也因此受到冲击与挑战。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #1
programme.desc: 跟随丽兹·戴利及其团队前往潘塔纳尔,追寻一只失踪的雄性美洲豹领袖,并亲眼目睹年轻挑战者之间的战斗。见证局外人巴达洛如何篡夺权力,并赢得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的欢心。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #2
programme.desc: 一起拜会潘塔纳尔美洲豹族群的女王菲拉,从旁观察她教导淘气的幼宝宝辛巴如何爬树和捕猎。然后看看另一只雌豹菲琳娜如何面对更多当地雄豹入侵领土,并威胁幼宝宝的存活。面对考验,她必须为母职挣扎坚持。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #3
programme.desc: 跟随科学家团队在雨季过后重新走入美洲豹领地,进行一次具规模的搜索,以寻找菲琳娜、菲拉和巴达洛,因为他们的追踪项圈已经丢失。迎接一位生物学家加入团队,在他的协助下,丽兹·戴利为美洲豹重新安装追踪项圈,并添置高科技设备以记录更多数据。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #4
programme.desc: 经历风暴、洪水和停电,莉兹和兽医霍亚雷斯仍奋力为更多美洲豹戴上项圈,情势相当紧张。一起寻找巴达洛的下落,并尝试在追踪标签掉落之前找到他,以及拜访一只团队渴望研究的新䧳豹。

programme.title: 美洲豹日志 #5
programme.desc: 见证奥玛法瑞团队为新认识的䧳豹阿罗艾拉戴上项圈,并一瞥她的豹宝宝阿波罗。继续追查巴达洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失踪可能让莉兹的突破性研究毁于一旦!

programme.title: 雪豹猎奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与丹一同踏上旅程,穿越严酷无情的蒙古荒野,只为寻找那只史上有纪录以来体型最大的雪豹: 「老兄」(The Dude)。目睹他如何在充满敌意、危机四伏的地形与环境中奋力前行,并在未知与不确定中披荆斩棘,同时揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面临的艰难挑战与严峻现实。

programme.title: 野狗: 与族群一起奔跑 #5
programme.desc: 和朱尔兹在捕猎行动中追上曼兹族群,和他一起拍摄一场野狗捕猎大战;在卡库里族群冒著巨大的风险等待雨季到来时,留意猎豹和鬣狗的活动。与一只归来的鹤群公犬一起进行一次史诗般的狩猎。

programme.title: 爱尔兰: 野性岛屿 #2 英普
programme.desc: 走访世界著名的斯凯利群岛,穿梭令人眼花缭乱的峭壁,并探索一座有1500年历史的修道院。拜访栖身曼岛的薙鸟和座头鲸,然后在克莱尔追逐矮小的鼩鼱。最后来到阿兰群岛,一睹秋季的壮观景象。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #1 英普
programme.desc: 跟著名叫奥廉巴的莽撞雌豹,游览尚比亚卢安瓜谷的心脏地带。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #2 英普
programme.desc: 奈士富狮群生活在尚比亚的卢安瓜河畔。见证经验丰富的雌狮养育一群幼狮,还有牠们如何在恶劣环境中努力生存。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #3 英普
programme.desc: 两头大雄狮,有著强大的兄弟情谊,统治了奈士富狮群三年,但三年是很长的统治期,其他竞争者逐步进逼。两兄弟将要竭力保护家族和领导地位。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #4 英普
programme.desc: 一头名叫美祖木的年轻雄性鬣狗的故事,围绕生命中最具挑战性的旅程- 找一个新家族。作为一名主导雌性的儿子,牠有一个被优待的童年,但当牠的地位在青春期时下降,因牠被母亲放逐了。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #5 英普
programme.desc: 一个野狗家族生活在尚比亚卢安瓜谷的一角。雌性的巢内有幼崽,这是她和伴侣生养的最新一窝。许多年龄较大的幼崽仍然在一起 - 牠们帮助作保姆,并狩猎食物养活家人。

programme.title: 非洲猎人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 在鬣狗家族中有一个新面孔。 斑斑注定要成为位于尚比亚卢安瓜谷心脏地带斑鬣狗族群的首领。她自出生起已有崇高身份,但她仍然需要证明自己。族群是一个危险的地方,她必须为自己打出一席位。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #1 英普
programme.desc: 与非洲森林象一同穿越纳米比亚沙漠,窥探牠们如何在缺乏食物与遮蔽的环境中保持凉爽。了解这头巨兽如何挑选特定植物充饥、挖掘水井,并翻越无尽的沙丘寻找珍贵水源。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #2 英普
programme.desc: 走访婆罗洲的红树林,与湾鳄一同航行,并见证牠们在盘根错节的水生植物之间穿梭自如。了解牠们如何利用环境调节体温,以及如何凭借惊人的耐性一跃成为顶尖猎手。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #3 英普
programme.desc: 红毛猩猩是丛林中的建筑大师。跟随麦克斯来到婆罗洲的雨林,一起探索这种独居灵长类动物的筑巢艺术。然后见证麦克斯如何尝试逃离满布昆虫的地面,并从红毛猩猩身上学习自然界工程技巧。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #4 英普
programme.desc: 跟随麦克斯来到卢安达的森林追踪黑猩猩,他试图说服这些强壮的猴子相信他是朋友而非敌人。一起学习在丛林觅食的关键技巧,并见证黑猩猩复杂的家庭动态,包括梳理毛发和社交活动。

programme.title: 野兽绝地求生记 #5 英普
programme.desc: 跟随麦可斯探索斯里兰卡,窥探懒熊常被误解的神秘世界。见证这种看似人畜无害、毛发蓬乱的动物,如何无畏地击退豹子,并观察牠们如何努力获取所需的营养。

programme.title: 翱翔澳洲 #1
programme.desc: 从内部干燥的平原上可以看到澳洲最知名的影像,红色巨石乌卢鲁,慵懒地跳跃的红色袋鼠; 澳洲的干旱中心地带是巨大又具标志性的。

programme.title: 翱翔澳洲 #2
programme.desc: 大狄维亭山脉被巨大的力量所打造,从大陆的中心地带以一条细长的绿色丝带分开。从塔斯曼尼亚的冰冷山峰经过1800英里,到达古老的戴恩树雨林,无数的物种以大狄维亭山脉为家,全都适应地生存,并茁壮成长。

programme.title: 野火劫后 英普
programme.desc: 以澳洲最近发生灾难性森林大火的后续,透过充满希望、人为干预和复原力的故事,记录野生动植物的长期恢复情况。本节目发放了一个十万火急的讯息,不要太迟爱护大自然。

programme.title: 金伯利: 澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​与小袋鼠一起躲避长满鳞片与覆满羽毛的危险威胁,观察库拉马那蜥蜴为了争夺配偶而激烈交战,并与刚孵化的鳄鱼幼体一同进食。在雨季来临之际,勇闯危险的急流,理解一条在地河流在文化层面与生物层面上的重要意义。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #1 英普
programme.desc: 认识在喀拉哈里盆地合力确保共存的罕有合作者。了解大象族群与结果白相思树的共生关系、猫鼬与吵闹卷尾鸟的联盟,以及更多一对对动物相。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #2 英普
programme.desc: 喀拉哈里的动物们渴望雨水,因为牠们已经忍受了极端干旱的一年。见证象群在拼命寻找水源时的合作,邂逅帮助小猫鼬生存的奇怪保姆。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密联盟 #3 英普
programme.desc: 跟随到达喀拉哈里沙漠的科学家并验证一个假设: 动物合作是该地区爆发物种多样性的关键。观察他们监控行为、破译数据,并得出引人入胜的结论。

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #3
programme.desc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑战肾上腺素极限: 潜水探险、水上飞行器、挥杆高尔夫、快艇狂飙——最后边晚餐边畅聊《哈利波特》回忆,输家买单!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #4
programme.desc: 在波兰,苏菲抛下宁静假期,换来满满刺激: 征服壮丽塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探访传奇盐矿,精彩不间断!

programme.title: 朋友与他们的产地 #5
programme.desc: 在因斯布鲁克,双胞胎带海莉闯入阿尔卑斯仙境,飞驰滑雪、雪车冲刺、尽情畅饮,重温童星荣耀时刻——还有神秘魔法惊喜!

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 随著日照越短、天气越寒冷,加拿大的野生动物正与时间竞赛,任何无法好好利用秋天作准备的动物都将灭亡。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既残酷又美丽;动物们在冰天雪地里挣扎求存;不过,虽然有些动物会静候蓄力,另一些需要抚养孩子的动物则需要迅速适应环境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一个迟来的春天,但当它终于来到,寻觅配偶和组织家庭的竞赛就正式开展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的树蛙,东部的两万只塘鹅,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 重机梦想家之基努李维 #8

programme.title: 博物馆的秘密 3 #1
programme.desc: 《博物馆的秘密》带观众深入伦敦 VA 博物馆幕后,展出康斯特勃的版画、桑迪・鲍威尔的签名西装、法贝热的英国作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性艺术家萝拉・豪威尔创作的新漫画插图。

programme.title: 博物馆的秘密 3 #2
programme.desc: 本周于 VA 展出: 一套为男装展打造的粉红亮片西装、搬迁至东伦敦分馆的罗宾汉花园十吨建筑切片、青年馆展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉维利斯的《旅行》茶具组。

programme.title: 博物馆的秘密 3 #3
programme.desc: VA 的策展人挖掘物品背后的未知故事,包括非洲时尚、一块肯特布料、一张詹姆斯・巴纳摄影作品,以及一只令人困惑的「古波斯」餐盘。

programme.title: 摩根费里曼: 打破障碍
programme.desc: 摩根费里曼是荷里活最知名的演员之一,以其有力的声线和温文的举止见称。尽管他的特质广为人知,但真实的他却不是众所周知。

programme.title: 惠妮休斯顿: 天籁背后
programme.desc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描绘惠妮休斯顿如流星般崛起的人生——从福音音乐的根源到全球巨星的巅峰,揭开错综复杂的情感关系、与成瘾搏斗的阴影,以及那把曾无可动摇、最终令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮。

programme.title: 席琳狄翁: 爱无止境
programme.desc: 席琳狄翁是家喻户晓的名字,象征著无与伦比的音乐才华。然而,她的人生并非一帆风顺。跟随我们一同揭开传奇背后的故事——从声名鹊起的爆红之路,到塑造她非凡事业的个人考验。

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #3

programme.title: 非洲的空中历险 #5

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既残酷又美丽;动物们在冰天雪地里挣扎求存;不过,虽然有些动物会静候蓄力,另一些需要抚养孩子的动物则需要迅速适应环境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一个迟来的春天,但当它终于来到,寻觅配偶和组织家庭的竞赛就正式开展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的树蛙,东部的两万只塘鹅,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季对大部分动物来说都是丰收的季节,但对北极熊却相反。在海洋再度结冰前,牠们无法捕猎海豹,导致日益饥饿。对其他动物来说,夏天是幼崽们必须学习如何生存的时机。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #5
programme.desc: 国土虽小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加拥有全球 5% 的物种。从山巅到海岸,亲身体会守护这座丰富生命圣殿对地球是多么至关重要。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #1
programme.desc: 冬季的结束预示世上最大型又疯狂的觅食潮来临,大型海洋猎食者瞄准在阿拉斯加湾寻求庇护的数百万条鱼。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #2
programme.desc: 随著春季来临,日照变长,气温上升。不过,阿拉斯加只有短暂的春季。动物只有两个月时间来觅食和组织家庭,还要避开猎食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #3
programme.desc: 阿拉斯加已进入夏季。这为世上最大规模之一的阿拉斯加三文鱼迁徙准备了舞台。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #4
programme.desc: 座头鲸回归阿拉斯加丰饶的食堂,三文鱼则回到河流产卵。不过,牠们必须跟饥饿的棕熊讨一条生路。

programme.title: 下一站: 缅甸

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#83粤
programme.desc: 署名家明的人突然在全港所有媒体，刊登一份寻人启事，相约「玫瑰」和他再续二十年前未了缘，众人揭发玫瑰是丽。亨协助将丽「大变身」赴会。丽思前想后，认为应以最真一面见人，决意回复平日的打扮去见初恋情人家明。

programme.title: 尚食#23粤普
programme.desc: 紫萍为子衿送膳，发现没有妃嫔去拜会，她心里不服气；自瞻基向子衿送上礼物后，各宫娘娘看到子衿受宠，都到子衿的院里争先献媚；瞻基亲自向子衿送上同心锁，坦诚对她的真心；皇后的寿诞上，后宫各人争先向皇后送礼。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 鼎植口腔呈献：齿中守护你粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷亲到本地蔗田拣靓竹蔗，再教大家煲「竹蔗茅根马蹄饮」。香口蔗虾令食指大动，鼎爷还特意将蔗切成扁平状，以加入肥猪肉的虾胶包住。想成品松化，在调制粉浆时需下点功夫。鼎爷再以原条黄鳝炮制「黄鳝焗饭」，饭熟后放上洗好的黄鳝焗熟，然后𪷽油及淋上煲仔饭豉油；腌黄鳝时加入生粉有何作用？将黄鳝起肉切丝，则可制作「银芽肉丝炒鳝糊」，先将鳝丝腌香走油。烹调时如何减少银芽出水？菜式上碟后，鼎爷在蒜上𪷽猪油，提升香味！

programme.title: 汇丰保险呈献 :准备退休有乜计粤
programme.desc: 退休是一段崭新的人生篇章，值得细心规划与期待。若可提前安排好财务、健康、生活的方向，便能于退休后真正享受自在和安稳。王祖蓝、李亚男这对演艺圈的模范夫妇，引领观众从不同方面切入，认知退休所需准备，务求可在财务与生活规划上更周全，得以轻松迎接属于自己的人生新阶段。

programme.title: 汇丰Premier Elite 呈献：《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》粤
programme.desc: 金融市场瞬息万变，加上科技发展日新月异，如何影响投资市场？《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》，云集不同行业专家，剖析市场趋势，讲解金融、投资及理财等话题，务求做到深入浅出，聚焦分析不同议题，为大家捕捉市场先机。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 皮肤如受紫外线刺激，容易出现色斑、皮肤暗沉。学者细述色斑中的雀斑、晒斑、荷尔蒙斑特征，并提供舒缓建议。他还分享挑选防晒产品贴士，解释「SPF」与「PA」的含义。家庭心理治疗师指出，离婚人士多会出现指责、忧郁等心理阶段。若未能妥善疏导，容易令双方产生更多争拗。父母离异亦可能影响子女，甚至带来负面情绪。亲友如想支援离婚者，嘉宾建议从陪伴与聆听着手。「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie师傅巧炸一道「怀旧上海春卷」。

programme.title: 医度讲粤
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎是近年大疫情，持续数年，备受市民关注。《医度讲》这集请来朱智贤细述患上新冠肺炎的经过，并有陈占耀医生为大家解构新冠肺炎与「长新冠」问题。注册中医师何慧欣、营养师李澄琳也会在节目中跟大家分享治疗及预防新冠肺炎的食疗。

programme.title: 五味人生#15粤PG
programme.desc: 永祯与双春逃走时不慎堕崖，双春为救永祯身陷险境；永祯竟趁机向她表白……飞扬正欲赞赏九妹能练成将菜式的味道统一，九妹却坦白说出自己的病情。镇长与所长及乡亲到临关家，提出将为双春设立贞节牌坊；关老太众人赞成，双春没法提反对……永祯通知双春决定带她离开佼佼镇；但当冷静下来，却担心双春跟随自己会变成骗子夫妇，要求九妹带双春离开。若岚威迫利是妹供出双春与人约会地点；更以大少奶身分要众人助她捉奸……

programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日

programme.desc: 上海设有不少千奇百趣的博物馆，陈约临到访「失恋」博物馆，却勾起一段段美好而痛苦的回忆；再踩入玩味十足的「即食面世界」，竟玩到「索晒气」？紧接转往琉璃博物馆，培养艺术气息。人气书局以全透明玻璃设计，「伪文青」约临慕名前来打卡兼买书，好梦幻！特色中菜餐厅主打多种Fusion美食，「北京烤鸭」配爆炸糖同吃，引发味蕾新冲击！约临及后换上华服走进怀旧舞厅，用餐之余，也到舞池摆动身体，感受浪漫的上海滩情怀。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 香料虽只是菜肴中的配角，却可提升味道层次，不可或缺。主持们这次在农场采摘迷迭香、小茴香等香草，还找到清甜的粟米，返回厨房制成惹味非一般的「椒盐粟米」。黄姜有改善关节炎等功效，「黄姜茴香煮野鸡」既滋味又有益。上碟前阿妈特意加入牛油，有何妙用？另一道「香草杂菜炖猪柳」，则是佐饭推介。阿妈又用绍酒烹调西式菜「香草煮青口」，中西合壁更添美味。二人期间突然上演「正字厨房」，6号更疑有发音困难，究竟发生何事？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 雪胶含有丰富植物胶质，养颜功效媲美燕窝。肥妈还为「粟米蟹肉雪胶羮」加入矜贵蟹黄，鲜味随之激增！白玉木耳的爽脆口感令人想起海蜇，因而启发出「凉拌白玉木耳」配搭灵感。肥妈悉心主理这道消暑美食，一个透明胶袋何以成为让食材入味的秘物武器？假不但可乱真，也未必比真货逊色。阿妈采用高蛋白质、具降脂功效的鲜猴头菇制作「素咕噜肉」，倍添健康而且美味依然。「酥皮焗荷兰小牛柳」则以香脆酥皮锁紧鲜嫩肉汁，尽显烹饪智慧。

programme.title: 不可能任务粤
programme.desc: 五位艺员的任务，是建造一条可行驶客货车的桥梁。众人前往建造学院接受训练，允瑜的衣著竟成焦点？建桥涉及扎铁、钉板、落石屎等工序，如掌握相关机器的用法，过程可望事半功倍，衍峰却错手「搞乱档」！钰洧屈铁造「洛仔」时的表情，竟似在坐过山车，但总算获导师给予七十分评价。钉板看似只是「揼钉」，若要做到合格，必需虚心学好当中技巧，德贤实战过才知其困难。徐荣亦视这趟工地体验为挑战，希望学以致用，有助解决家居问题。

programme.title: 不可能任务粤
programme.desc: 经过基本工序训练，五位艺员于导师们指引下，在搭好的桥梁底座钉板，钰洧、允瑜感谢导师耐心地指导揼钉，并由衷敬佩建造工人。接着是扎铁，喜欢做重复工作的钰洧获赞，笑言想转行？落石屎、拆板之后，土木工程系区教授随即检查桥身混凝土的强度，五人的建桥表现又值几多分？徐荣与钰洧、允瑜登上客货车，为桥梁进行负重测试，车内美女怕得要死，车外的衍峰、德贤同样紧张万分……不可能任务结束，众人回顾个中历程，有何深刻感受？

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 余思霆收拾好行李，请一日假便飞台北，获地胆拍档金刚接机，即搭机场捷运向市中心出发！旅程第一餐品尝足料鸡腿汤，未吃完已心思思要到宁夏夜市，寻觅同获「车胎人」推介的芋饼、猪肝汤与蚵仔煎。日间于隐世咖啡店享用三层塔茶点，夜晚深入窄巷酒吧，启动门口机关，走进以蜂巢为主题的设计格局并浅酌一番。翌晨，两人排长龙买早餐，再登上公园边赏花边医肚，偏黑色的卤肉饭有多滋味？下午行程有两款选择，叹啡、浸温泉，悉随尊便。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 旅途第二晚，吃到尽！先有抵食海鲜加肉材一人一锅，其他配料、蔬菜任添，再来意想不到的盐酥鸡当宵夜；连放松做Spa都有点心吃？第三日早上，两大行程可拣，好动的可以滑水，金刚体验「沙发滑水」，感受如何？爱静的可跟思霆往赤峰街商圈做个文青，购物、打卡、来个小清新套餐。终极血拼阶段，到永康街一带寻找合适手信，台湾特色小食、茶叶、精致生活小物，任君选择。上机前再享用炭火烹制的姜母鸭，记住金刚建议最后才吃鸭肉！

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 何艳娟(Katherine)，毕业于香港大学法律系，体现港姐「美貌与智慧并重」的格言。Katherine才貌双全，制作一般甜品当然难不倒她，古嘉俊于是给她进阶挑战，试做花巧、层次丰富的「法式红莓榛子泡芺」，测试她的厨艺。红莓吉士以牛奶、蛋黄、淡忌廉炮制，幼滑口感为食家带来窝心感受，新鲜红莓散发的天然果酸还添上清新口味。做律师要心思细密，繁复步骤未能难倒Katherine，体力反而成为她的最大考验。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 太晴一行人在落合带领下前往九州接受训练，认识到当地的驾驶员海风九十九。进行模拟战斗时，九十九欲进行支援合体，却因指令员经验不足而失败。室长中谷希望落合帮忙指导两名新进指令员。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 女生在「My Little Show」带来节奏感十足的敲击乐演出，并提到可用不同棍子制造各种特色的声音。两男两女团队则表演节拍舞蹈，动作合拍，展现活力。欢聚唱歌时间，这次以「团结的力量」为主题，彤彤姐姐、Tiffany姐姐和结他导师合唱<一枝竹仔、<最佳拍档。主持们还分享拍摄《Hands Up》的深刻点滴，彤彤姐姐被拍档笑称是「小傻瓜」！此外，导师亦即场「拆解」结他，让观众认识其内部结构。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 改编自人气绘本。各位小朋友快跟著无人不知的名侦探屁屁侦探全面出击，透过细心观察及推理，侦破各类案件吧！

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 宏志和阿山去河边钓鱼，却突然闹反，小丸子和小玉看在眼里，决定要永远做好朋友，友谊永固。花轮邀请大家到家里掷飞镖，小丸子志在吃到美味甜点，却因为陶醉于美味达到心无杂念，成功命中红心。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 三月一手住宅买卖有回落迹象，反而二手交投却显著增加，究竟本地楼市有多大的复苏动力？越来越多零售店会在店内同时兼卖咖啡，这个安排对带动整体业务有几大影响？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
星期日档案粤
programme.desc: 在三、四十年代，日本军国主义兴起，逐步扩大对华侵略，亦看中中国东北地区肥沃的黑色土壤，计划20年间向中国东北迁移一百万户，称为「日本开拓团」，打算透过不断输送农业贫民来到东北，试图变成日本永久的殖民地，不过后来日本战败，军政府自顾不暇，开拓团团民亦要展开逃亡，当中有四千多名日本儿童，因此被遗留在中国，成为了日本遗孤。今集将会了解两名日本遗孤，郜凤琴及大原朋二，被中国养父母抚养成人的故事。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港何济公止痛退热散呈献：中年好声音4粤
programme.desc: 本轮「快慢二重奏」分为两集，二十强参赛者依据上轮成绩轮流拣选歌曲，组成二人团队，以合唱形式开展队制对垒，并分别举行慢歌上半场、快歌下半场的比拼。每场对垒后，评审们会在胜出队伍中挑选一位选手，颁发晋级襟章。当快慢歌比拼全部结束后，未能获得襟章的选手中，将有两人被淘汰，而这集率先上演慢歌比拼。

programme.title: 一周星星粤
programme.desc: 罗志祥的巡唱即将举行香港站，有何准备？他幽默回答是要喝红豆冰！「小猪」这暱称其实源自年少时很胖，也因此备受霸凌，他还自揭腿上「伤疤」。母亲近年确诊亚兹海默症，小猪于是常贴身照顾她，一次陪诊，却被医生告知自己患有微笑忧郁症？小猪指出，每个人都要找到抒发情绪的出口。打高尔夫球又让他学会了甚么？「你问我答」，关嘉敏斗胆拍片在高手面前讲冷笑话，要求评分；叶泓声感谢小猪曾转发其演出片段，更亲自到场答谢偶像！

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 星厨陈佑良带波波到访一间主打生炸鸡髀的餐厅，试吃流心芝士吉列猪扒及招牌生炸髀，陈师傅更示范生炸髀的特别吃法。荃湾地胆Ryan推介区内泰国餐厅，必吃咖喱软壳蟹配烤饼、烧猪颈肉饭及鸡肉串烧，并分享私藏的地胆吃法。晖哥与鼎爷造访星级中菜馆，细味老菜脯脆皮烧鹅及工序繁复的辽参佳肴，满是惊喜滋味！中韩混血儿李明宪则带叶靖仪品尝韩式炸鸡，包括枫糖蒜香及秘制酱风味，同样皮脆肉嫩，还有玫瑰忌廉炒年糕，酸辣惹味。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
叠影狙击#19粤PG
programme.desc: 晨和杰合作，欲以杀雄来引出Cat。另一方面，Mag亦奉命杀雄，雄为保命，命Cat绑架飞以威胁晨当自己保镖及杀Mag，晨假意顺从，暗中拜托杰和诺找飞。晨被擒，诺为救晨向Mag开出优厚条件。飞获救，惟身受重创…

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 跟过往旅途不尽相同，何沛珈、李芷晴这次放工后才到机场，抵达泰国曼谷已入夜，沛珈未忘为好姊妹准备猛男生日派对，并附大量海鲜！狂欢过后，已是行程第二天。换上校服，走进大学感受校园气息，再到学生长龙店食碗「妈妈面」。花半小时坐车往近郊一间咖啡店，值得吗？原来是网美胜地，还可划小艇和打千秋，打卡、休闲皆一流！创意市集寻宝，她们看上了哪款时装？随后登上由旧飞机改造的餐厅，享用廉价精致餐饮，暂时放低减肥大事。

programme.title: 请1日假去旅行粤
programme.desc: 沛珈、芷晴租著泰服，再乘观光船往郑王庙留影，打卡初尝教训后，提醒大家要早点到场，究竟怎么回事？两女自言第一次享受Spa，单是拣精油已花去不少时间。然后试试「曼谷十大名厨」之一主理的摘星餐厅菜肴，卖相与美味兼备。走入夜市，当然要买手信！节目组为主持各提供一千泰铢斗买得多，沛珈讲价不成都照买，满脑策略的芷晴执行力又怎样？此外，行程亦有酒吧、设计周活动推介。旅途最后一晚，她们于泳池中互诉心声，感触良多。

programme.title: 甜心先生粤

programme.desc: 上海设有不少千奇百趣的博物馆，陈约临到访「失恋」博物馆，却勾起一段段美好而痛苦的回忆；再踩入玩味十足的「即食面世界」，竟玩到「索晒气」？紧接转往琉璃博物馆，培养艺术气息。人气书局以全透明玻璃设计，「伪文青」约临慕名前来打卡兼买书，好梦幻！特色中菜餐厅主打多种Fusion美食，「北京烤鸭」配爆炸糖同吃，引发味蕾新冲击！约临及后换上华服走进怀旧舞厅，用餐之余，也到舞池摆动身体，感受浪漫的上海滩情怀。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 香料虽只是菜肴中的配角，却可提升味道层次，不可或缺。主持们这次在农场采摘迷迭香、小茴香等香草，还找到清甜的粟米，返回厨房制成惹味非一般的「椒盐粟米」。黄姜有改善关节炎等功效，「黄姜茴香煮野鸡」既滋味又有益。上碟前阿妈特意加入牛油，有何妙用？另一道「香草杂菜炖猪柳」，则是佐饭推介。阿妈又用绍酒烹调西式菜「香草煮青口」，中西合壁更添美味。二人期间突然上演「正字厨房」，6号更疑有发音困难，究竟发生何事？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 雪胶含有丰富植物胶质，养颜功效媲美燕窝。肥妈还为「粟米蟹肉雪胶羮」加入矜贵蟹黄，鲜味随之激增！白玉木耳的爽脆口感令人想起海蜇，因而启发出「凉拌白玉木耳」配搭灵感。肥妈悉心主理这道消暑美食，一个透明胶袋何以成为让食材入味的秘物武器？假不但可乱真，也未必比真货逊色。阿妈采用高蛋白质、具降脂功效的鲜猴头菇制作「素咕噜肉」，倍添健康而且美味依然。「酥皮焗荷兰小牛柳」则以香脆酥皮锁紧鲜嫩肉汁，尽显烹饪智慧。

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 当你沉睡时
programme.desc: 拥有预知梦能力的洪珠，因总是只能梦见未来却无力改变而让她痛苦。不是金汤匙出生也没有优秀的学历及人脉，却总是富有充满正义感的检察官宰璨。两人的相遇为了阻止梦境的可怕事件变成现实，开始相信对方是否能成为扭转未来的人呢?

programme.title: 另一种蓝(完)
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 大学成人式-被不良少年迷住3-
programme.desc: 【《鱿鱼游戏》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，众多偶像齐聚一堂，共谱青春爱情剧！！】因一场误会让模范生妍斗与校园恶霸贤浩有了连结，在结束了高中时期的纷扰，进入大学就读的妍斗与贤浩，以为平静的日子将会是日常生活。随著新认识的朋友，两人想解决复杂的误会和矛盾产生，看似复杂的爱情公式，谁才是妍斗最终的选择?

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地气的外景行脚节目,由名人带领网路红人到店家体验吃、喝、玩、乐。寓教于乐，带给观众耳目一新的超强体验。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 粉红色口红
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠经典复仇之作好闺密为渣男反目成仇】因做错抉择导致人生本末倒置的女人，经过4次婚姻终于找到真爱与幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初恋情人当成全部，放弃了自己的梦想，却得到彻头彻尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，图谋佳恩家的财富和地位与佳恩结婚，在达到目的后将佳恩抛弃，转而和情人美兰结婚，阴谋夺得了佳恩父亲的公司，并间接害死了佳恩的父亲。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步从一位百合般纯洁的女人，变成了带刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 当你沉睡时
programme.desc: 拥有预知梦能力的洪珠，因总是只能梦见未来却无力改变而让她痛苦。不是金汤匙出生也没有优秀的学历及人脉，却总是富有充满正义感的检察官宰璨。两人的相遇为了阻止梦境的可怕事件变成现实，开始相信对方是否能成为扭转未来的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花总相逢
programme.desc: 本剧改编自蓝艾草的同名小说，许清嘉自幼父母双亡，寒门苦读成榜眼，与世交胡家的小女胡娇喜结连理。胡娇虽然出身屠户家，不通文墨，但性格开朗积极、不拘小节，将一切打理得井井有条。

programme.title: 南风知我意
programme.desc: 【《莲花楼》成毅在搭张予曦，再现《与君歌》绝美默契！！】药物研发员傅云深与外科医生朱旧至偏乡进行人道医疗救援，两人从误解到经历生死危机而两情相悦，彼此还不及坦承心意就遭逢巨变，从此断绝联系。一年后的重逢，面对傅云深的刁难与变化，朱旧坚韧及乐观并不离不弃的守候，陪他度过每个春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 大学成人式-被不良少年迷住3-(完)
programme.desc: 【《鱿鱼游戏》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，众多偶像齐聚一堂，共谱青春爱情剧！！】因一场误会让模范生妍斗与校园恶霸贤浩有了连结，在结束了高中时期的纷扰，进入大学就读的妍斗与贤浩，以为平静的日子将会是日常生活。随著新认识的朋友，两人想解决复杂的误会和矛盾产生，看似复杂的爱情公式，谁才是妍斗最终的选择?

programme.title: 人气封锁中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同时作为转学生的机率，是旼财意想不到的巧合。与作为人气女王敏在协议交换身份生活，原本逐渐透明的生活开始画上色彩。随著时间害怕被拆穿，同时只在敏在面前直率的申义俊，在他的陪伴与守护找到自我。

programme.title: The Korean Dish Expedition - The Korean Dish Expedition Ep.9
programme.desc: The heirloom cuisine of Korea’s traditional clan families carries generations of wisdom rooted in harmony with nature. Some flavors have faded, others nearly forgotten?but at the refined yet simple tables set by the family matriarchs, viewers experience a moving journey back in time.

programme.title: A royal culinary class - A royal culinary class Lesson 1. “Guksu-bibim”
programme.desc: We’d tried to reproduce “Guksu-bibim” which was described as a simple dish enjoyed in daily life on the book 「Puinpilji」, written in Joseon Dynasty.

programme.title: A royal culinary class - A royal culinary class Lesson 2. “Sengbogeo-eumjeok”and "Semyeon"
programme.desc: We’d tried to reproduce “Sengbogeo-eumjeok” (Pan-Fried Abalone Skewers) and "Semyeon" (Mung Bean Noodles in Omija Honey Water).

programme.title: A royal culinary class - A royal culinary class Lesson 3. “Jang Jjanji”and "Jeonbok Chimchae"
programme.desc: We’d tried to reproduce “Jang Jjanji” (Pickled Cucumber) and "Jeonbok Chimchae" (Stuffed Abalone in Salty Water).

La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Bedroom
programme.desc: Chilli and Bandit transform the old nursery into a new bedroom for Bluey. In the process, Bluey and Bingo amicably divide their belongings, but get absorbed by trading items and swapping notes at bedtime. Ultimately, when Bluey misses her sister, she asks to return to her old room.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Rollercoaster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Love Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask: does he still love them? In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk shows them the answer is a resounding YES.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S3) - Go Jet Academy: Rainbow
programme.desc: After a rainbow appears over the Go Jet Academy, Glitch becomes fascinated with the legend of a pot of gold appearing at the end of it.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Neighbours
programme.desc: Bluey needs her Mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour, when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's own growing stable of animals.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Grandad
programme.desc: Grandad is supposed to be resting, but when Bluey and Bingo go to visit him, he makes a run for it with the kids and takes them on a madcap adventure into the bush.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.desc: Globetrotting Andy, Jen and Scout are on a new mission in their Eco-Explorer: to discover more about incredible animal families and their babies.

programme.title: Playtime Towers (S1) - Star
programme.desc: Bella and Lift are visited by a shining star and set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. The first stop is Sketch in Boxtropolis - what will she be making today?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Theatre Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels help to put on an amateur dramatic show.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Shadow Badge
programme.desc: There has been a power cut and the squirrels use their torches to make shadows.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Collecting Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The squirrels are inspired to make their own collections.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - The Sphinx, Egypt
programme.desc: Glitch and the Grimbots are on holiday in Egypt where the Grimbots bury the Great Sphinx in sand, leaving only its head showing.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Everglades National Park, Florida
programme.desc: The Go Jetters save the Florida Everglades when hungry alligators chase Glitch's picnic.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Max and Monty's antics on a construction site get them into trouble.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Duck's Quack
programme.desc: Sarah suggests visiting the spare sounds section of the Big Shop when Duck loses his quack.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Parasol Show
programme.desc: Umbrella is nervous about meeting up with his pen pal at the Parasol Show, so Sarah &amp; Duck accompany him.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Big Wheel
programme.desc: Stanley helps Seamus and Little Woo reconstruct the Big Wheel from Seamus' childhood. This is more difficult than Stanley thought it would be as it needs a clean and an upgrade.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Buttons
programme.desc: Little Woo would like Stanley to help them find more noisy things in the museum. They go through the museum and pick out some things for a new exhibition.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals (S1) - It Was So Hot.. I Got Chicken Pox!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Bedroom
programme.desc: Chilli and Bandit transform the old nursery into a new bedroom for Bluey. In the process, Bluey and Bingo amicably divide their belongings, but get absorbed by trading items and swapping notes at bedtime. Ultimately, when Bluey misses her sister, she asks to return to her old room.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Rollercoaster Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Grandad

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa‐Laa follow a trail of muddy footprints and find Po in bed with very muddy feet. The Noo-Noo cleans off the mud.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after it is attacked by the Qing army and is badly wounded. He is handed over to the Qing soldiers by Fang as he mistakes Hong for a bandit. When Fang realizes his mistakes, he tries all ways to help Hong escape so that they can team up to fight the Qing army together.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed "The Invincible Fist" is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Black Enforcer
programme.desc: Lung the Black Enforcer is ordered to escort a murderer Fei to prison. While taking shelter in Lung's house from the snowstorm, Fei is rescued by his gang and Fei kills Lung's mother and sister before escaping. Lung is imprisoned for the failed task and after being released, he vows to avenge his family by killing Fei.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: The Avenging Eagle
programme.desc: Qi Ming Xing, an assassin of the Iron Boat Clan, decides to quit the clan. When hunted by the clan, he is saved by Swordsman Zhuo Yi Fan. Zhuo accidentally discovers that Qi is the killer of his wife, but forgives him after knowing Qi's guilt over her death. The two finally team up to destroy the evil clan.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes on a job as a night guard. As the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at the abandoned building, only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Apok-ta-pokalypse Now Part 2
programme.desc: The team heads into a final confrontation for the weapons that not only threatens Tikal, but their lives. And Po must share hero duties with Mastodon.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - A Cause for The Paws
programme.desc: Po, at the top of his game but lonely, comes across two weasels stealing an earthquake causing gauntlet and tries to stop them, but inadvertently destroys a town. He loses his title as Dragon Master and teams up with Wandering Blade, a knight on a mission from England, to track down the weasels and get his title back.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Mother's Day
programme.desc: The arrival of Tronos - a bounty hunter with the power to control electricity - sparks an investigation by Area 49-B that threatens to expose the Royals’ alien identities. Meanwhile, Mother watches as the Royals struggle to work together to deal with this new threat.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Ill Gotten Gains
programme.desc: When Colonel Kubritz issues a medical quarantine that locks down the high school, Aja and Krel must avoid capture with help from their friends. Meanwhile Vex, Zadra, and Stuart have a run-in with a familiar face.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - There's Something About Gwen (of Gorbon)
programme.desc: When Stuart’s larger-than-life ex-girlfriend surprises him with a visit, Aja, Steve, Vex, and Nana join them on a triple date- where issues from each of their relationships come to a head. Meanwhile, Krel, Toby, and Eli discover a new passion: Sci-Fi filmmaking.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - A Tale Of Two Turbos The Escargot Affair
programme.desc: Turbo is surprised to learn that somebody in town is pretending to be him and must find the imposter before they can cause more trouble. Turbo is invited to a fancy dinner party in his honor but learns that he is actually on the menu, so it's up to the crew to save him.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Surf N Turf Hardcase Returns
programme.desc: The snails' relaxing day at the beach is threatened when the sewer surfing roaches challenge them to a surfing contest. Hardcase returns and threatens to take revenge on, so the crew becomes his bodyguards and takes the job a little too seriously.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - Lake Ball Pit The Poppy Corn Festival
programme.desc: Cannonball! Archibald becomes a lifeguard at Lake Ball Pit. When Loy can't get along with a rival, Archibald gets a lesson in the art of sarcasm.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Stuck Toys
programme.desc: When Noddy arrives at Toy Green Station, he finds some toys stuck to the ground: someone has spread some glue all over the station platform! Why would someone do that? Noddy investigates.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Untidy Pirates
programme.desc: It's Tidy Toyland Day and Noddy wants to win the Tidy Toyland Trophy. Unfortunately he's also invited the untidy Pirates round to play! Noddy has to figure out how he can play with the Pirates and win the Tidy Toyland Trophy.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Ruined Race
programme.desc: It's the Brickabuild Sports & Fun Day and Clockwork Mouse tells Carlton she doesn't want ANY accidents. But when the Egg & Spoon Race comes to a grinding halt, Noddy has to find out who is trying to ruin the race.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Investigation Kit
programme.desc: It's the Royal Egg Hunt and Noddy's investigation kit goes missing. With Bumpy and Revs, Noddy soon finds some of his things, but not his binoculars. Someone must be using them, but what for? Noddy needs to find out in time before the Egg Hunt starts.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hippo Has No Hair
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hippo did have hair… lots of hair! She was always harumphingly hot. Then one hot night while Hippo was sleeping a spark from the fire caught the end of her hairy tail! Hippo was on fire! She ran through the bush until SPLOSH! Hippo jumped in the waterhole. And from that day on Hippo stayed in the cool waters without a single hair on her hide. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Tortoise Has A Broken Shell
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Tortoise's shell was all shiny and smooth. One day Tortoise discovered the birds were having a Feast in the Heavens and he tricked the Birds into making him a pair of wings. Greedy Tortoise raced the birds beyond the clouds and scoffed the whole feastt! When the Birds found out Tortoise had to jump off a cloud until BOOF!!! He landed on his shiny shell.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Eco Igloo
programme.desc: Mrs Goggins is spearheading a recycling initiative "A Greener Greendale" but has been overwhelmed by donations of plastic bottles and compost. Meanwhile, Pat picks up today's special delivery - blocks of ice to make an igloo at the school for their North Pole project. Pat and Ajay struggle to get the slippery blocks into PAT2, then Pat and Jess must endure a journey with the air-con on full blast to keep the blocks frozen. Despite this, the ice starts to melt on the way to the Schoolhouse.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Reckless Rollers
programme.desc: Pat is delivering some new car wash rollers to Ted, but the locks on his van doors are faulty. As Pat negotiates an obstruction in the road, the van doors fly open and the rollers fly into a field of startled sheep! Integrating them into their flock, the sheep make off with them, and Pat and Jess take chase, creating more chaos on the roads. Meanwhile, PC Selby has arrived at the car wash, eager to get the panda car cleaned for his date with Dr Gilbertson.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Car Boot Sale
programme.desc: Big Chris has a clear out and takes all his old junk up to Farmer Green's car boot sale but misses the clutter in Rusty. How will he get everything back?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Hot Stuff
programme.desc: Big Chris takes the cars to the beach to relax in the heat but he is so busy dealing with the cars he forgets to drink his water. But hang on, who else has drunk it…

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Law And Order
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is fed up with the cars running amok on his track and summons Bill and Nick to restore order to the track. But might our overzealous policeman overstep the mark?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Flash's Tea Party
programme.desc: Flash invites everyone to a tea party, thinking they bring the food with them. Are there going to be a lot of hungry bunnies at Silver hatch?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Torn-Out Pages
programme.desc: Someone's ripped out the final pages of Queen Sparklewings Fairytale book! Who could it be ? Noddy needs to find out fast and restore the pages to the book or the Queen's special fairytale storytelling will be cancelled.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Bird That Can't Fly
programme.desc: Noddy finds a bird in Pat-Pat's Treehouse that doesn't seem to be able to fly. He decides to investigate: how can they help the bird to fly? Noddy finds out that the bird can fly - it just doesn't want to. But why ?

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Clockwork Mouse Mystery
programme.desc: Everyone in Toyland is excited about the first ever Winter Light Festival - except its organiser, Clockwork Mouse who is moving at super fast speed. Noddy helps her realise that she doesn't have to do all the festival preparations on her own. Well done Noddy!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Smartysaurus

Noddy has to help Smartysaurus get back to her proper size and find a way for everyone to enjoy the Night of the Stars together. Good job, Noddy.

programme.desc: The snails and Tito travel to Tokyo to film a commercial and Turbo is challenged to a drift race against a beautiful and mysterious female cricket.

programme.desc: In order to investigate one of Skidmark's conspiracy theories, Turbo and Skid join a dangerous underground zip line raceThe crew is surprised when Whiplash enters the town's annual Tomato Games. Turbo discovers that Whiplash is really trying to keep an eye on an untrustworthy snail who is Whiplash's former mentor.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Paperbirds Rock And Egg Roll
programme.desc: A gang of crooks mistakes Archibald for a criminal mastermind. Archibald unearths a rock with mysterious - and feather-raising - powers.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Upset Captain
programme.desc: Pirate Captain says he doesn't want to be the captain anymore. Noddy investigates how they can help him and he soon finds the reason for the Captain's distress: someone took his beard! Noddy sets out in search of the missing beard.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of Revs &amp; Tractor
programme.desc: Revs and Tractor are doing Tom's deliveries together, but only Tractor comes back. Why isn't Revs with Tractor? Tractor is too upset to explain what happened, so Noddy investigates to find his friend.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Toyland Circus
programme.desc: It's the Toyland Circus and all the toys are rehearsing an act - all except Smartysaurus, who rushes away, apparently too shy to take part. Noddy has to find a way to help Smartysaurus find an act for the circus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Deltoid's Missing Strength
programme.desc: Action-hero Deltoid suddenly loses all his strength and finds himself totally helpless. Noddy quickly starts an investigation: How can he help Deltoid get his strength back?

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Hen Pecks The Ground
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Hen didn't peck the ground. She was a proud mother who spent all her time looking after and cleaning her chicks. Fancy pancy Peacock upsets Mama Hen and makes her feel plain. All the animals are furious with Snooty Peacock… but the damage has been done. Eagle - Mama Hen's best friend - decides to lend Hen her most prized possession - A needle! And Mama Hen sews herself the most beautiful coat of new feathers. Everyone is delighted and they dance and dance and dance.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Bat Hangs Upside Down
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Bat didn't hang upside down. He used to fly all over Tinga Tinga, saying ‘Boo!' to all the animals and giving them a fright. Nothing could be more fun for Bat. But one day Bat went too far… and the animals decided to give Bat a dose of his own medicine. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat's Camping Chaos
programme.desc: Lauren and Sara lead a camping trip to the Scottish Highlands, but disaster strikes when Ajay and PC Selby are stuck in Pencaster with the tent and cooking equipment. Pat must transport them to the Highlands in the SDS Plane and put up the tent before nightfall in order to accomplish his mission.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The King's Armour
programme.desc: It's Knights and Dragons Day at school and Pat has to travel to a Welsh castle to pick up some ancient artefacts and Sarah Gilbertson's Auntie Jackie! Pat is rather partial to a suit of armour - and when he's presented with a real one at the castle, he can't resist trying it on! But the suit gets stuck shut, leaving the excitable children wondering where their artefacts are!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Horse Powered Dinkie

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - FB's Sleepover

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cici Spectacular

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Cry Cold
programme.desc: Big Chris is feeling ill so Marsha sends him to bed until he is better. Big Chris enjoys the attention rather too much and fails to let everyone know when he is on the mend.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Silent Parrot
programme.desc: The Pirate Captain is very worried. Scurvy the parrot isn't saying a word. Without him navigating they won't be able to go treasure hunting anymore! Why is Scurvy so quiet? Is there something wrong? Or is he hiding something? It's up to Noddy to investigate!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Vanished Ninjas
programme.desc: The Ninjas are preparing for an acrobatics show. But after Pat-Pat decorates them with glitter they don't turn up for their rehearsal. Noddy investigates, looking for the Ninjas, but only finds sticky things have gone missing round Toyland - Pat-Pat's glue-stick, the Naughticorns' sticky tape, the Builders' sticky putty. Noddy works out that the glitter made the Ninjas non sticky, so they borrowed sticky things to try and make themselves sticky again. Case closed!

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Missing Suitcase
programme.desc: Pat-Pat is packing for a sleepover at the Palace when her suitcase goes missing. Noddy follows the clues and discovers that the Pockets took the suitcase in order to get Pat-Pat's sleepy pillow. They wanted to keep the pillow because it reminds them of Pat-Pat and they would miss her while she was at the sleepover. Noddy finds the Pockets and the suitcase in the dark, just in time for the sleepover. Queen Sparklewings invites everyone to the sleepover. Well done Noddy!
